Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE production-ready game character sprite-sheet atlas for the Japanese historical RTS KAMAKURA, 1179-1221. Create a square transparent PNG divided into an EXACT uniform 3 by 3 grid, NINE isolated full-body warrior character sprites, one perfectly centered in each equal square cell, row-major order. No visible grid, no text, no labels, no scenery, no floating emblems. Each cell has generous transparent margins, no sprite crosses a cell boundary, all feet at same relative baseline. Cinematic hand-painted realistic Japanese historical strategy-game art, exquisitely detailed late-Heian o-yoroi lamellar armour, dynamic dignified poses, crisp silhouettes readable at 128px, three-quarter front view, dramatic warm rim lighting. Each man unique face, silhouette, armor color and helmet. These are artistic interpretations, not documented portraits. Stand on foot, show entire body and weapon without crop, no modern or Sengoku-era plate armour, no guns, no horned fantasy demons, no horses.
Row1 col1 MINAMOTO NO YORITOMO: commanding man early thirties, calm stern face, dark indigo and ivory armor, black eboshi under restrained helmet, longbow at side and sheathed tachi, noble leader.
Row1 col2 TAIRA NO KIYOMORI: imposing elderly bald samurai statesman, crimson and gold armour with black monk-like mantle, commanding tachi stance, broad face with grey moustache.
Row1 col3 MINAMOTO NO YOSHINAKA: rugged vigorous mountain warrior in his thirties, deep green and russet o-yoroi, broad shoulder guards and long naginata, fierce expression.
Row2 col1 FUJIWARA NO HIDEHIRA: distinguished older northern lord, purple and muted gold armour, fur shoulder edging, pale horsehair helmet crest, composed bow stance.
Row2 col2 TAKEDA NOBUYOSHI: mature veteran with weathered face and grey beard, red-brown and dark gold lamellar armour, sturdy helmet and heavy longbow.
Row2 col3 HOJO TOKIMASA: calculating older warrior, ochre and charcoal armour, compact rounded helmet, tachi held low, sharp eyes.
Row3 col1 MIURA YOSHIAKI: very old indomitable white-haired veteran, sea-blue and iron-grey armour, long white beard, spear used as fighting staff.
Row3 col2 CHIBA TSUNETANE: silver-bearded mature warrior, chestnut and pale gold armour, broad sode shoulder plates, tall longbow, enduring confidence.
Row3 col3 KAZUSA HIROTSUNE: formidable broad-shouldered bearded eastern warlord, rust orange and black heavy o-yoroi, large tachi with forceful diagonal stance.
All nine should look cool, heroic and distinct, belonging to one consistent polished art direction. Transparent background throughout.
